source.cdef: ffi.cdef blocks in ui/**/*.lua of each extracted tree
source.exports: the PE export name table of each version's own X4.exe
source.probe: C.<name> and ffi.sizeof measured in game, both Lua states

probe.addonsShared: a name any ui/addons or ui/widget file cdefs resolves in the shared addons state; env is therefore reachability, measured exactly in both versions
probe.coreIsolated: a ui/core script sees only the cdefs of its own file, so env "core" never means reachable: declare what you use
probe.exportedResolve: every exported-only name resolves once declared, in both states, in both versions; none is missing from the binary
probe.restrictedWording: Access to FFI function '<name>' is restricted!
